sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD38/AA, Barking Riverside.
The current Brownfield range is 10,800 minimum to 20,000 maximum net dwellings over 179.37ha.
The record is permissioned with outline-planning-permission dated 7 August 2007.
The record states the permission date relates to 10,800 homes, several reserved-matters applications followed, and a new application sought higher numbers.
The current record marks the site deliverable.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority and is not a named proprietor/title relation.
The Brownfield record supplies a point and blank geometry, not the 179.37ha legal/title topology.
March 2026 Planning Committee HTML records 24/01141/OUTALL as a new outline proposal for up to 13,046 homes and 52,848sqm non-residential floorspace.
The 13,046 figure is the remaining/new outline application scope and is not added mechanically to the 10,800 or 20,000 site-wide figures.
Regulation 19 HTML identifies AA Barking Riverside as a Local Plan allocation attachment.
Historic reserved-matters approvals concern phases and infrastructure under the wider outline framework and are not additional site capacity.
No complete current application-to-phase-to-HMLR title topology for the 10,800, 13,046 and 20,000 scopes was verified this wave.

examples.result: AA retains a current 10,800–20,000 Brownfield range.
The 2007 date is tied to the 10,800-home outline permission.
The 2026 NOPA's 13,046 homes are not added to 20,000.
Reserved-matters approvals do not create extra site-wide capacity.
Local Plan allocation is not a substitute for application finality.
Private/non-public ownership category is not named-owner evidence.
A point is not a 179.37ha title boundary.
Promotion remains zero until phase/application/title topology and overlays are complete.
